title: Peak margin snapshot to trading member (MCXCCL)
purpose: Each client's upfront margin at an MCXCCL peak-margin snapshot, with the allocation and other collateral then, and any short allocation.
linked: Loaded as MCXCCL's peak margin snapshots: the latest is the clearing corporation's intraday margin in live RMS, the highest is shown on margin reporting

columns.name: Total Upfront Margin
columns.note: initial margin + ELM + net buy premium

columns.name: Short allocation
columns.note: upfront margin less allocation and other collaterals, if above zero

source: MCXCCL File Formats (Version 1, Public), section 1.32 Peak Margin Details File to Trading Member; MCX circular MCX/TECH/394/2023 (19 Jun 2023), MCX File Formats Version 1.2, section 1.62
